comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked to the dollar. the other inclusive end of the range: the SAME K-1 with the deductible part of the box 14 code A loss stated as 0 - the whole 6,000 loss suspended by the basis, at-risk and passive limits the partner applied off the return. Measured: /k1SeEarnings is 0.00 (against -6,000.00 in the sibling), self-employment tax is 0 as if box 14A were blank, and /knockoutK1NegativeSeEarnings is false. Box 1 is unchanged, so every served line matches wages-and-k1-se-loss-single: 42,250 income, taxable 26,500, tax 2,945 = 1,192.50 + 12% of (26,525 - 11,925), 3,055 overpaid. The pair is deliberately line-identical - with no other self-employment earnings Schedule SE floors at 0 either way - and what it locks is that a 0 answer is an ANSWER and not a missing one: the same fact set with the field absent is refused by name before the engine is called.
